validation.alternate_hr_rule: Over hit counts use locked L10 values strictly greater than the listed alternate line; exact ties are not counted as wins.
validation.core_rule: Available FanDuel alternate odds between -350 and -150 inclusive; choose odds numerically closest to -250; ties choose more negative odds.
validation.floor_rule: Immediately lower available alternate threshold than Core.
validation.ceiling_rule: Immediately higher available alternate threshold than Core.
validation.narrowing_rule: Carry forward complete Floor/Core/Ceiling structures where Floor historical HR >=8/10 or Core historical HR >=7/10; no context research used.
